records.note: Later withdrawn after Sylas was identified as nonfunctional.

positiveUnderdogKillHandicap.assessment: The cushion was repeatedly overvalued while SK's functional damage, objective position, and structured-fight conversion remained poor. The same thesis was re-entered after being correctly withdrawn for Sylas having zero impact.

killTotalOver.assessment: The late Over was supported by observed kill velocity, completed damage items, and continued two-sided fighting; it was materially different from draft-only Over speculation.

modelReview.primaryError: Repeatedly treating a widening positive handicap as sufficient protection despite the underdog lacking functional mid-lane impact, objective control, and qualifying fight conversions.
modelReview.processError: After the SK handicap thesis was withdrawn because Sylas was nonfunctional, later SK handicap leans were issued without the required evidence of thesis repair.
modelReview.operationalAdjustment: Once a positive-underdog kill-handicap thesis is withdrawn for functional collapse, apply a same-map re-entry lockout. Re-entry requires two new qualifying structured-fight conversions plus clear structural stabilization and restored item-qualified return damage.
modelReview.positiveFinding: The late Over 37.5 correctly used observed fight velocity and item strength rather than draft engage density alone.
